lines.t:
A <c:ffff00>sub-skill<c> that performs a <c:ffff00>combo attack<c>.
Unlike a normal <c:ffff00>attack<c>, no <c:ffff00>{{target}}<c> is chosen when
choosing the command: when <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> completes, it
enters the <c:ffff00>CF Stance<c> instead of attacking.
When an {{ally_battle_term}}'s <c:ffff00>trigger<c> attack finishes {{prep}}, the CF
Stance ends and the combo attack is carried out.
<c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c> Crossfire attacks ahead of the trigger
attack; <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c> Crossfire attacks after it.
